title: 2024 buried-remains journal
prompt: Create one complete 16:9 documentary image for CAMP CENTURY. Image1 establishes the OWNER-APPROVED DRAWING STYLE ONLY: confident detailed ink and charcoal linework, restrained watercolor, paper tooth, blue-white snow, olive winter clothes, sparse rusty ochre objects. Do not copy its composition or subjects unless requested. Any additional image is FACT reference only. Match the drawing style, not a new design system. Full finished composition, large explanatory drawing, legible short English labels integrated into the scene/paper. A generated scientific editorial field-book plate in the approved drawing style. Focus on a detailed blue-watercolor ice cross-section with a SINGLE shallow horizontal band of fragmentary structural remains parallel to the surface. Do not draw any aircraft, sensing beam or radar wedge. The additional image gives buried-layer context only. Exact text only: 2024; BURIED STRUCTURAL REMAINS; At least 100 feet below the surface; Not an accessible city. No fake radar echogram, data grid, numerical axis, new measured returns, deep shafts, rock bottom or active underground rooms. Full purposeful field-book drawing, no boxes. All base artwork must be CLEAN: NO yellow highlighting, NO underlines, NO marker strokes, NO selection circles, NO loupes, NO glow or animated accents baked into the image; those are added later in DaVinci Resolve. No generic three-line title card, UI, HUD, floating boxes, fake official seals/signatures/stamps, tiny filler text, placeholders, empty panels, decorative noise or burnt parchment. Use 6 percent safe margins. This is authored explanatory artwork, not an original archival record. No invented quantities, dimensions or measurement curves. No other projects or bases. Text only as explicitly specified.
